Handwritten Journal

An iPad app where a child says what happened today and writes it in their own hand. Every page is kept. The journal never leaves the iPad.

© 2026 Matt Vorst. Handwritten Journal is an independent app. The basic app is always free; we will never sell your data. See the privacy policy.
